title: Fan-shaped residuals
statement:
Residuals are tightly around 0 for small x but spread out more and more as x grows. This is called …

[_]{a}

explanations: It's a trend in the spread, not one point.
There's no curve, just growing spread.

hints: Look at the spread, not the center.
solution: Uneven spread of residuals across x is heteroscedasticity: the line is less accurate for large x.
